en: A vintage-style colored postcard showing a tranquil outdoor cafe or park area with several wooden tables and chairs set up beneath large leafy trees. There is a small stone-lined canal or stream running through the middle, and at the far end, a round stone structure possibly covering a spring or fountain. People are casually gathered near the structure and along the tables. The overall setting appears lush and relaxed. Text is faintly visible in the lower left, and a watermark from elia.org.gr is present.
